fact: Ethiopia's House of Peoples' Representatives enacted the Critical Infrastructure Cybersecurity Proclamation (No. 1426/2026), with fines of 1.5 to 2 million birr for failing to report incidents within 48 hours.
title: Ethiopia Enacts Proclamation No. 1426/2026 Mandating Fines Up to 2 Million Birr for Unreported Cyberattacks
